source.probe: Aptos hmtx x the corpus pair-kerning factor baked into an advance-matched Carlito derivative (tools/build-metric-fonts.py); general face corpus-weighted, box = Carlito hhea x the general size-adjust undone

note:
Aptos (M365 default body face since 2023): Word renders the real font, but
it ships only inside Office, so Chromium never resolves it and the chain
fell to Carlito, 5% narrower per line, one line short per paragraph (SAS
probe 2026-09-03: seven samples, pitch stays Calibri's 1.22). Aptos is not
a scale of Carlito: per glyph the ratio spans 0.87 (M, t, r) to 1.22 (C, s,
c), so one factor fitted over whole lines left capitals 2.7% and bold 1.3%
short and moved a wrap every two pages (prod corpus 2026-10-20). Each face
therefore declares the corpus-weighted letter scale as its general rule and
one range-limited face per 1.5% advance bucket of the ASCII letters, digits,
space and common punctuation; later faces win inside their unicode-range.
Ratios = Aptos hmtx (Word DFonts / cloud-font cache) over Carlito hmtx,
times the face's mean pair-kerning factor (0.9957-0.9963 over the corpus):
Word kerns every run under the 2024 Normal template (docDefaults kern 2)
and HarfBuzz kern+liga reproduces its PDF line widths exactly, while
Chromium cannot kern across the bucket faces. The metric overrides undo
each face's size-adjust on the vertical axis (overrides scale with
size-adjust) so every bucket carries the line box of the 106.5% Carlito
face the pagination model (line-metrics.ts) assumes: a 1.22x capital
bucket otherwise grew a 12pt body line 0.4pt. Generated: do not hand-edit
the numbers, refit them against the font files.

2026-10-31: the bucket faces made letters of one word differ in height (size-adjust
scales both axes; 'aCronymS' in sample 019). The ranged faces are replaced by one
advance-matched derivative per cut (AptosGO-*.ttf): Carlito outlines scaled
horizontally to each Word advance x the kerning factor, one vertical factor (H/x ink
ratio), hmtx = Word advances, GPOS/kern dropped, U+00A0 mapped to the space glyph.
hhea/OS2 carry the general face's line box so the pagination model is unchanged.
